observedFailurePattern.description: Repeated auth bounce after provider/OAuth roundtrip without achieving guest home or authenticated account marker
sequence: Navigate to official root entry https://chatgpt.com/
User initiates login -> redirected to auth origin or child window https://auth.openai.com/ or Google/Apple OAuth
Instead of hydrated guest home or user account session, page immediately displays login required or redirects back to auth origin
User is trapped in repeated login prompt loop
observedFailurePattern.offendingCookieStatus: Specific offending cookie unknown; root cause not established

scopedRemediation.method: Explicit manual cookie expiration across exact three ChatGPT-owned origins
prohibitions: NO clearing shared Google account session or credentials
NO clearing sessions of other AI providers (Gemini, Claude)
NO automatic execution without explicit user confirmation
NO reset on ordinary first login, challenges, guest-with-login-button, or UNKNOWN states
NO persistence or export of cookie names or values

recoveryAffordance.trigger: Loop detected after >=2 failed returns/excursions to auth origin
recoveryAffordance.ui: Error-only affordance with native confirmation dialog
recoveryAffordance.postResetAction: Single user-initiated fresh root reload with LOAD_NO_CACHE
